source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Antigua, Atitlán Gölü ve Tikal güvenlidir; başkentin belirli dış bölgelerinde artırılmış güvenlik tedbirleri gerekir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise increased caution due to crime; tourist hubs Antigua, Atitlán, and Tikal are well-policed.
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht wegen Kriminalität; touristische Hauptziele wie Antigua, Atitlán-See und Tikal sind sicher.
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность из-за криминогенной обстановки; Антигуа, озеро Атитлан и Тикаль охраняются туристической полицией.
advisory_headline.es: Ejerza mayor precaución debido al crimen; destinos turísticos como Antigua, Lago Atitlán y Tikal cuentan con custodia.

regional_warnings.reason: Elevated gang activity and violent street crime; avoid non-essential travel to these zones.

esim_sim_notes.value: Central America-4 (CA-4) agreement allows travel across Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, and Nicaragua within the single 90-day allowance. Claro and Tigo offer prepaid 4G tourist eSIMs.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: CA-4 Border Control Agreement unifies free movement between 4 Central American states

tr.conditions: Türkiye Cumhuriyeti umuma mahsus, hususi ve hizmet pasaportu hamilleri CA-4 anlaşması kapsamında 90 güne kadar vizeden muaftır.

us.conditions: US citizens can travel to Guatemala visa-free for up to 90 days under the CA-4 Border Agreement.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens do not need a visa for tourist stays up to 90 days in the CA-4 zone.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can visit Guatemala visa-free for stays of up to 90 days across CA-4 countries.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ въезжают в Гватемалу без визы на срок до 90 дней в рамках соглашения CA-4.

dos.title: Ask before photographing indigenous locals
dos.description: Always politely ask permission before taking photos of Mayan women and children in traditional huipil dress.

dos.title: Use PROATUR tourist police escorts for hikes
dos.description: For volcano treks (like Volcán de Agua or San Pedro), requesting a free tourist police escort ensures safety.

dos.title: Bargain respectfully in Mayan markets
dos.description: Haggling in traditional markets like Chichicastenango is customary, but maintain a friendly, respectful tone.

donts.title: Don't use public 'chicken buses' at night
donts.description: Colorful converted school buses (camionetas) are prone to reckless driving and robberies; use private tourist shuttles.

donts.title: Don't walk alone on quiet roads between Lake Atitlán towns
donts.description: Trails between villages around Lake Atitlán have historical robbery risks; take public lancha motorboats instead.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is standard in sit-down tourist restaurants in Antigua and Panajachel.
